novel_mechanism: Learn a 16-coordinate intervention-response feature basis over 72 public counterfactual outputs (6 target entities x 12 future interventions). Group complete latent terminal hypotheses by learned feature code; merge a class only after checking it against the independent 72-bit full predictive signature, and otherwise keep separate full predictive signature residuals. This is learned state-representation selection with proof-carrying exact fallback, not T26's redundant learned Boolean dynamics truth table.
